content.title: MLB Opening Day 2026: How to watch Yankees-Giants season opener
content.text: March 25, 2026, 2:11 p.m. MTMajor League Baseball is ready to begin its 162-game season in what has turned into an opening weekend full of baseball.The first official regular-season game, Opening Day, arrives Wednesday, March 25 when the New York Yankees head across the country to play the San Francisco Giants in an interleague game. This is the first time the stand-alone season opener has been an interleague game.There will be 11 more openers on Thursday as the rests of the league swings into action.When is MLB Opening Day?Opening Day is Wednesday, March 25.Who is playing on Opening Day?The New York Yankees will travel to San Francisco to play the Giants.What time is Yankees vs. Giants?The game will start at 6 p.m. MT/7 p.m. CT.Where to watch New York Yankees vs San Francisco GiantsThe game will stream live on Netflix.Yankees vs. Giants pitching matchupThe Yankees will start Max Fried. The Giants will start Logan Webb.Yankees vs Giants last gameThe last time these two teams met was early in 2025 in a three-game series when the Giants took two of the three games.Opening day historyThe Cincinnati Reds traditionally hosted the first game of the year as part of a city holiday, and they are still always at home for their first game. In 1994, the MLB created a nationally televised game the day before the rest of the league opens.MLB opening day TVSpecific opening week MLB games will air across NBC, Apple TV and Netflix; the rest
